# Alexandre DO-O ALMEIDA

> Public professional profile and resume of Alexandre DO-O ALMEIDA, Lead AI Software Engineer based in Montpellier, France, working remotely.

This optional summary helps readers find the canonical source pages. The English and French HTML profiles contain the full resume and are readable without JavaScript. Professional information is self-reported by the profile owner; use the linked profiles for the current wording and dates. This file does not grant or restrict crawler access.

## Resume

- [English profile](https://cv.zqsdev.com/): experience, technical skills, education and contact information.
- [Profil en français](https://cv.zqsdev.com/fr.html): expérience, compétences techniques, formation et coordonnées.
- [English PDF](https://cv.zqsdev.com/resume.pdf): downloadable version of the English resume.
- [PDF en français](https://cv.zqsdev.com/resume-fr.pdf): version téléchargeable du CV français.

## Professional focus

Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI evaluation, software architecture, product engineering, CI/CD and test automation. Languages and frameworks include Go, TypeScript, React, Python, Java, SQL, Rust, C++, C# and WebAssembly.

The resume describes work with Studi / Galileo Global Education, Sony Interactive Entertainment / PlayStation through Implicit Conversions, Jam.gg (formerly Piepacker, Y Combinator S20), Atos, Airbus Helicopters and CNRS. Roles and dates are detailed on the canonical profiles.
